title: God Made the Water
objective: Students will learn that God created oceans, rivers, lakes, and rain.
content: God made all the water in the world! He made big oceans, long rivers, and pretty lakes.
Water is so important! We drink water. Animals drink water. Plants need water to grow. God gives us water because He loves us.
Rain comes from the clouds that God made. Rain fills up the rivers and lakes. Rain helps flowers and trees grow. Thank you, God, for water!
activity: Pour water from one cup to another. Talk about how water moves. Color a picture of a lake or ocean.
